$comment: Meta-schema for extractor.json files (L12). Extractors declare a role, never a model — capabilities.json maps role -> model with typed fallbacks. registry.js reads `required` and `properties` from this file as the single source of truth for its hand-written validator, so this file and the validator can never drift apart. A top-level "model" key is explicitly forbidden by registry.js (not by omission alone) so the error message can cite L12 directly.

role.$comment: key into capabilities.json roles (e.g. "extraction") — never a model id

scope.$comment: e.g. "call" (single-call) vs a future cross-call scope

output_schema.$comment: portability subset only: Anthropic ∩ OpenAI structured-output schema; see registry.js lintPortability

keywords.$comment: role:"tracker" ONLY — deterministic keyword list scanned in code (src/extract.js), never model output. registry.js rejects this key on any non-tracker role and rejects a tracker missing it.
